overview: No competing analytics, no duplicate scoring frameworks, no redundant extraction scripts detected across 300/500/700/800 series tracks.

verificationPoints.detail: S302 DQS, S303 EQS, S304 BQS, S305 ExQS, S306 UIQS form a single layered quality stack. No competing models.
UIQS (S306) is the authoritative unified score. DQS/EQS/BQS/ExQS are component inputs, not competing frameworks.
scripts/s302-* through s306-* are distinct per-session engines. No duplicated functionality.
CAQS_v1.0.md (case) and MCQ_CERTIFICATION_STANDARD_v1.0.md (MCQ) are domain-specific, not competing.
DIFFICULTY_CALIBRATION_STANDARD.md v1.0 is the single source. S713-S716 applied consistently.
500-series touches scored_cases*.js only. 700-series touches pack_*.js only. 800-series plans both but with strict lane separation. No overlap.

recommendation: No remediation needed. Existing governance guard, lane isolation, and session-level file-scoping provide sufficient conflict prevention.
